atthadhammasahitaṃ pure giraṃ, erayaṃ bahujanaṃ nidaṃsayi, pāṇinaṃ hitasukh'āvaho ahu, dhammayāgam'ayajī amaccharī.

examples.text: tatrā'pi te, phagguna, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na c'eva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati, na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi, hit'ānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto, na dos'antaro'ti.
idha cunda ekacco pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharati
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

idāni'ssa tathā duccaritacaraṇe kāraṇaṃ dasseti appassuto'ti, attano paresañ'ca hit'āvahena sutena virahito'ti attho.

71267.commentary: (JAa) hiriottappasampannā'ti hiriyā ca ottappena ca samannāgatā. tesu kāyaduccarit'ādīhi hiriyatī'ti hirī, lajjāy'etaṃṃ adhivacanaṃ. tehi'y'eva ottappatī'ti ottappaṃ, pāpato ubbegass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tattha ajjhattasamuṭṭhānā hirī, bahiddhāsamuṭṭhānaṃ ottappaṃ.

examples.text: satthugaru dhammagaru, saṅghe ca tibbagāravo, hiriottappasampanno, sappatisso sagāravo, abhabbo parihānāya, nibbānass'eva santike'ti.

71278.meaning1: power that is conscience; strength of a sense of shame
71278.commentary: (PM) katamaṃ hiribalaṃ? nekkhammena kāmacchandaṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. abyāpādena byāpādaṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. ālokasaññāya thinamiddhaṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. avikkhepena uddhaccaṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. dhammavavatthānena vicikicchaṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. ñāṇena avijjaṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. pāmojjena aratiṃ hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. paṭhamena jhānena nīvaraṇe hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ… arahattamaggena sabbakilese hirīyatī'ti, hiribalaṃ. idaṃ hiribalaṃ. (ANa) ahirike na kampatī'ti hirībalaṃ.

examples.text: satta balāni, saddhābalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.

71279.meaning1: fact of having a conscience; scrupulousness

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, sappurisena sappurisataro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti, parañ'ca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti, attanā ca hirimā hoti, parañ'ca hirimatāya samādapeti, attanā ca ottappī hoti, parañ'ca ottappe samādapeti…

71280.commentary: (MNa) hirī etesaṃ mane, hiriyā vā yuttamanā'ti hirimanā.

examples.text: pare ahirikā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha hirimanā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
